tasks.answer: Use DeleteDiscussion, a destructive confirmation control for deleting a discussion. It takes the discussion id (string) and is wrapped in an admin Authorization check; render it inside an authenticated route.

The login form uses Input. Bind react-hook-form by passing its registration object: registration={register('email')} (registration is required); use it inside Form so FieldWrapper supplies label and error.
The discussions list's table pagination control is TablePagination. It needs totalPages (number), currentPage (number) and rootUrl (string, without a query string; links are rootUrl?page=N).
MDPreview safely renders Markdown. Its input prop is value (the Markdown text).
CreateDiscussion is an admin-only drawer form that creates a discussion with a title and Markdown body. It requires the Authorization provider; only admins see the trigger. It has no required props.

notes: All four discovery searches used --limit 10 --brief; the brief view supplied ID/importPath/requiredProps and was enough to pick candidates, so no normal (summary) searches were needed. Three gets total: one combined get for ui.form.Input + discussions.CreateDiscussion (react-hook-form registration constraint and admin-only authorization), one get for ui.table.TablePagination (confirmed the three required props), one get for discussions.DeleteDiscussion (id + admin wrapper). No project files read and no catalog JSON read directly.
